resources.string: Al AzharTex uses your camera to photograph physical A4 fabric shade carts and extract swatch colors and numeric labels. You can also upload an existing photo from your gallery.
Camera access is permanently denied. Open system app settings to enable Camera permission, or upload a shade cart photo from your gallery.
This digital shade cart has no color swatches recorded. Detect swatches from a captured card or add them manually.
ML Kit Subject Segmentation needs a one-time on-device model download. Until it is ready, you can continue with crop-only editing.
